'''Stuart Lauder''' won the [[1997 Brisbane Open]], a qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]].<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

"I'm 22. After attending University as an Information Technology student, I now work as a computer technician in Brisbane. I've always been a Star Trek and Star Wars fan and have played Customizable Card Games since they first came out. I enjoy that Star Wars CCG players play for fun. I know I do. I would also like to say 'Hello' to all the Star Wars CCG players in Brisbane - thanks for all the Support. And a special 'Hello' to my girlfriend Helen, who has to suffer through my addiction with me."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/lauder.html Stuart Lauder], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990427232052/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/lauder.html Internet Archive]</ref>
